lines.text: This is Anduril's YFQ-44A Fury. No cockpit, because no pilot.
lines.say: This is Anduril's Y F Q forty-four A Fury. No cockpit, because no pilot.
It first flew on Halloween, twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Under its wing: an AIM-120 AMRAAM. Since February it had flown with an inert one. This time it would fire.
lines.say: Under its wing: an A I M one-twenty, Am-ram. Since February it had flown with an inert one. This time, it would fire.

lines.text: It took off from Edwards with the 412th Test Wing.
lines.say: It took off from Edwards, with the four-twelfth Test Wing.

lines.text: Over the Mojave, in what the Air Force calls secluded airspace.
lines.say: Over the Mojave, in what the Air Force calls secluded airspace.

lines.text: Anduril's account is short. Its Lattice software ingested a target track.
lines.say: Anduril's account is short. Its Lattice software ingested a target track.

lines.text: An operator tasked the aircraft to engage.
lines.say: An operator tasked the aircraft to engage.

lines.text: A human gave the order. The aircraft took the shot.
lines.say: A human gave the order. The aircraft took the shot.

lines.text: The target existed only as data.
lines.say: The target existed only as data.

lines.text: The War Zone calls it the first live missile shot by any American CCA-type drone.
lines.say: The War Zone calls it the first live missile shot by any American C C A type drone.

lines.text: Anduril called it an end-to-end, beyond-line-of-sight strike.
lines.say: Anduril called it an end-to-end, beyond-line-of-sight strike.

lines.text: The Air Force's chief of staff: one step closer to delivering capabilities to the warfighter.
lines.say: The Air Force's chief of staff: one step closer to delivering capabilities to the warfighter.

lines.text: Production orders for both CCA designs were announced in June.
lines.say: Production orders for both C C A designs were announced in June.
